edition: JLCPCB PCB capabilities page as retrieved 2026-10-06 (no document revision stated)
notes: Fabricator figures read through a summarizing fetcher, re-read in a browser before use (R-21); fabs change limits without notice; example only, enter your fabricator's current values. Multilayer values are used where 1-2 layer values differ. 1-2 layer values: annular ring recommended 0.25 mm, absolute minimum 0.18 mm; minimum trace/space 4 mil / 4 mil (1 oz). Copper weights: 1 oz is the base outer copper only; other weights and inner-layer copper are not listed here.
